ingress_tree.digest_algorithm: sha256 over the UTF-8 text formed by concatenating, for each matching file sorted by base name, the base name, one NUL byte, the lowercase hex sha256 of the file bytes, and one newline
ingress_tree.git_tree_id_basis: git tree id of tools/mvp_ingress with the isolated launcher (branch fix/ingress-isolated-launcher), recomputed locally by the validator from file contents; supersedes the tree id at hub revision e7c7183687e756ccf839435ef2959fcafa126cdf
ingress_tree.file_list_rule: the validator refuses ANY entry under tools/mvp_ingress that is not one of the 8 expected regular files, including any __pycache__ directory, symlink, subpackage or non-.py file; there is no exception. Run with python -B or PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 so interpreter bytecode is not written there
ingress_tree.launcher_entry_point: python -I tools/mvp_ingress/launch.py --state-dir DIR --socket PATH --control-plane ROOT --runtime ROOT --allow-uid UID (--allow-uid is mandatory and explicit; the ingress refuses to start without it)
ingress_tree.interpreter_requirement_basis: the NC4-03 AST pins require CPython 3.13
ingress_tree.unclaimed_limitation: sys.path shadowing (hub-root or standard-library-name files in the working directory or hub root) is closed only for the supported isolated launcher form, python -I tools/mvp_ingress/launch.py, which refuses a shadowed ingress module and appends component roots after the standard library; the former python -m tools.mvp_ingress.server form is NOT covered. Also NOT covered: code running as the ingress uid or root, a peer running as an allowed uid (the allowlist binds client uids by configuration only), tampered interpreter, standard library or site-packages, and the host (Yama ptrace_scope).
